title: The sill
logline: January. The garage sill in rain: three jars, the sand dollar, and the bird, inside, on the sill, as if it had always been there. Wood's hand at the frame edge, drawing it. The rain.

panels.composition: The garage's casement window in January rain, from inside: the three jars — brushes, nibs, the sand dollar — and among them, on the sill, the rainbow bird, dry, unbothered, looking at the rain. At the bottom edge of the page, a hand holding a brush, mid-stroke, drawing it. The bird is the color; the rain is the gray; the hand is the line.

characters.pose: a hand with a brush at the page's bottom edge
on the sill among the jars
